node.title: A=1 core-one trace-free allocation rigidity
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the dominant norm residual is exactly the product of the local bad-row quotients N_x of degrees delta_x. In the trace-free nonzero-weld branch, every bad domain factor divides both A and B; the apparent W-allocation would force Qhat_x to divide E_Z, which also forces epsilon_x=1 and the contradictory degree deg Qhat_x=delta_x+1>=2. The exceptional factor has two exact allocations; in its B-allocation Q(gamma_0;X) is a squarefree degree-(r-1) divisor of G_X. After the forced allocations, both complements and the unit-product weld reduce to the exact square (TFA7). The reduced square and active traces remain open.
